description: backend.rs: SetError struct has no maxRecipients field. RFC 8621 §7.5: when tooManyRecipients is returned a "maxRecipients" UnsignedInt property MUST also be present. If a backend returns BackendSetError::SetError(SetError{error_type:TooManyRecipients,...}), the serialized JSON will never include maxRecipients, violating the MUST. The struct needs a maxRecipients: Option<u64> field (skip_serializing_if None) to carry this required property.
title: SetError struct cannot carry tooManyRecipients.maxRecipients
